sn55.45:1.1: catūhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo mahāyasoti vuccati.
sn55.45:2.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti
sn55.45:2.3: itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
sn55.45:2.6: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akkhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
sn55.45:2.7: imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo mahāyasoti vuccatīti.
